svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="12-identity-social" name="12 · Identity and social entities"><mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" page="0" pageWidth="2914.0" pageHeight="1057.0079999999998" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto" scopeDescription="Implemented entities and conceptual associations; database enforcement is stated in the constraint note." schemaConstraints="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId). Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user. role: roleId to id (declared SQL FK); user: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); token owner: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); requester: requesterId to User.id (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); recipient: recipientId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; blocker: blockerId to User.id (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); blocked user: blockedUserId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; successor: replacedByTokenId: optional logical successor (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)"><root><mxCell id="0" style="fontFamily=Arial;" value="" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" style="fontFamily=Arial;"
